title: Crash & Bump
description:
GAME FEATURES

• Play online with your friends.

• Try to eliminate other players while dodging obstacles.

• Get power-ups with each health pack.

• Customize your character.

 

• Laugh with the hilarious physics when eliminating opponents or being eliminated.

 

 

Note: Gamepad doesn't work yet. You can play with it in-game (not for menus), but it might not work as expected.

 

 

Note From The Developer

Hi everyone! I'm Darian, the creator of Crash & Bump, and I'm thrilled to introduce you to my video game. I was inspired by my love for shooter games but wanted to give it a different twist and thought that adding obstacles would be a fun way to do so, thus Crash & Bump was born. 

The entire game has been made by me, and it has taken me over 3 years to develop it so far. 

My goal with Crash & Bump is to offer a fun, action-packed gaming experience that puts your skills to the test. 

If you decide to purchase a copy, I want to thank you in advance for your support, and I hope you enjoy the game as much as I enjoy creating it. Thank you for playing Crash & Bump!
description_short: Crash & Bump is an online multiplayer shooter... mixed with obstacle courses! Eliminate your opponents while dodging the obstacles and take advantage of the power-ups to get the victory.
